preservedResponsibilities: Native FontMapExport preserves first raw family token, OpenSymbol/StarSymbol override, configured MS alternate and second-token fallback, retaining whitespace and UTF16 units. Native charset wrapper overrides only the original unknown/Unicode encoding cases. Actual unotools/SAL owners are consumed; native broader import/export/encoding helpers are unported.

V4DQJW adds the field-specific getPseudoCharRunsForDirection binding of GetPseudoCharRuns, using actual SwTextNode/GetWhichOfScript font items, genuine BreakIteratorImpl script queries, existing ICU default-mode resolved levels and original CharRunEntry records. Preserve empty-Latin run, UTF16 offsets, first-script-only charset selection/extension, weak/trailing-script handling, level rather than parity boundaries, merge order, source guards and erase predicate. The native SwDoc.GetTextDirection result is a required explicit input, never guessed. This helper does not pretend to implement the upstream one-argument entry point; the actual core layout-direction API/public wrapper and exporter traversal remain pending. Existing default-mode ICU level binding replaces physical UBiDi allocation/run tables only for this consumed mode; other modes and status/allocation APIs are not fabricated. Three native defensive branches remain uncovered under the successful concrete backend and the unchanged scoped100 gate fails; no fake provider/error result or exclusion was added.

Original private CanEncode and RTF font charset selection now use actual checked SAL byte-string conversion with the original cross-family 0x101 flags, Windows charset inversion, octet check, both primary/alternate names and exact MS932/MS936/MS950/MS949 fallback order/default1. A native byte-string scope supplies temporary ownership; no fake encoding provider or host codec is used. The source font-name algorithm is traced and directly tested but has not been independently compiled with full Writer/OUString/OString value classes. Native RTF font-table serialization remains pending.
